python3 -c "
import re, os

# Find all .rs files and look for .unwrap() and .expect() in non-test code
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('src'):
    for f in files:
        if not f.endswith('.rs'):
            continue
        path = os.path.join(root, f)
        with open(path) as fh:
            content = fh.read()
        
        # Split at #[cfg(test)] and take only the pre-test part
        parts = content.split('#[cfg(test)]')
        prod_code = parts[0]
        
        lines = prod_code.split('\n')
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith('//') or stripped.startswith('///'):
                continue
            if '.expect(' in line or ('.unwrap()' in line and 'unwrap_or' not in line and 'unwrap_or_default' not in line and 'unwrap_or_else' not in line):
                print(f'{path}:{i+1}: {line.rstrip()}')
"
